questions.question: By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct? + and ÷
questions.questionHtml:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and ÷
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Interchanging the given two signs so that the given equation will be correct.

Given: + and ÷ 

Let's check each option one by one:

Option 1) 9 × 18 + 27 ÷ 36 – 30 = 18

After interchanging the mathematical signs we get the:

⇒ 9 × 18 ÷  27 + 36 – 30 = 18

⇒ 9 × 0.666 + 36 - 30 = 18

⇒ 5.994 + 36 - 30 = 18

⇒ 41.994 - 30 = 18

⇒ 11.994 ≠ 18

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) 9 + 3 × 2 – 8 ÷ 1 = –1

After interchanging the mathematical signs we get the:

⇒ 9 ÷ 3 × 2 – 8 + 1 = –1

⇒ 3 × 2 - 8 + 1 = - 1

⇒ 6 - 8 + 1 = - 1

⇒ 7 - 8 = -1

⇒ - 1 = - 1

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 3) 16 + 8 × 2 ÷ 6 – 9 = 10

After interchanging the mathematical signs we get the:

⇒ 16 ÷ 8 × 2 + 6 – 9 = 10

⇒ 2 × 2 + 6 - 9 = 10

⇒ 4 + 6 - 9 = 10

⇒ 10 - 9 = 10

⇒ 1 ≠ 10 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 16 + 2 × 6 ÷ 3 – 7 = 50

After interchanging the mathematical signs we get the:

⇒ 16 ÷ 2 × 6 + 3 – 7 = 50

⇒ 8 × 6 + 3 - 7 = 50

⇒ 48 +3 - 7 = 50

⇒ 51 - 7 = 50

⇒ 44 ≠ 50

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct? 1 and 9
questions.questionHtml:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be correct?

1 and 9
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Interchanging the given two numbers to find which of the following equation will be correct.

Let's check each option one by one:

Option 1) 9 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 + 1 = 10

Given: 1 and 9

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 1 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 + 9 = 10

⇒ 1 × 3 - 2 + 9 = 10

⇒ 3 - 2 + 9 = 10

⇒ 12 - 2 = 10

⇒ 10 = 10

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) 1 + 9 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 = 18

Given: 1 and 9

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 9 + 1 × 3 – 4 ÷ 2 = 18

⇒ 9 + 1 × 3 - 2 = 18

⇒ 9 + 3 - 2 = 18

⇒ 12 - 2 = 18

⇒ 10 ≠ 18

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) 9 × 2 + 1 – 8 ÷ 4 = 12

Given: 1 and 9

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 1 × 2 + 9 – 8 ÷ 4 = 12

⇒ 1 × 2 + 9 - 2 = 12

⇒ 2 + 9 - 2 = 12

⇒ 11 - 2 = 12

⇒ 9 ≠ 12

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 9 – 1 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 7

Given: 1 and 9

After interchanging the numbers we get the:

⇒ 1 – 9 + 6 ÷ 2 × 3 = 7

⇒ 1 - 9 + 3 × 3 = 7

⇒ 1 - 9 + 9 = 7

⇒ 10 - 9 = 7

⇒ 1 ≠ 7

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

⇒ 177 – 11 = 28

questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27
questions.solution:
1) + and –

Given expression: 4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27

After replacing the symbols, we get:

4 ÷ 6 – 9 + 48 × 8 = 27

=> 0.67 – 9 + 384 = 27

=> 384.67 – 9 = 27

=> 375.67 ≠ 27

2) + and ×

Given expression: 4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27

After replacing the symbols, we get:

4 ÷ 6 × 9 - 48 + 8 = 27

=> 6 – 48 + 8 = 27

=> 14 – 48 = 27

=> -34 ≠ 27

3) ÷ and +

Given expression: 4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27

After replacing the symbols, we get:

4 + 6 ÷ 9 - 48 × 8 = 27

=> 4 + 0.67 – 384 = 27

=> 4.67 – 384 = 27

=> -379.33 ≠ 27

4) ÷ and ×

Given expression: 4 ÷ 6 + 9 - 48 × 8 = 27

After replacing the symbols, we get:

4 × 6 + 9 - 48 ÷ 8 = 27

=> 24 + 9 – 6 = 27

=> 33 – 6 = 27

=> 27 = 27

Hence, ‘÷ and ×’ is the correct answer.

Given that:-

156 - 13 + 9 × 18 ÷ 5 = 169

From option 1:-

÷ and +

  • After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 - 13 ÷ 9 × 18 + 5 = 169,

156 - 1.44 × 18 + 5 = 169

156 - 26 + 5 = 169

156 + 5 - 26 = 169(the positions of 26 and 5 are interchanged with their symbols)

161 - 26 = 169

135 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

From option 2:-

× and ÷

  • After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 - 13 + 9 ÷ 18 × 5 = 169

156 - 13 + 0.5 × 5 = 169

156 - 13 + 2.5 = 169

156 + 2.5 - 13 = 169(the positions of 2.5 and 13 are interchanged with their symbols)

158.5 - 13 = 169

145.5 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

From option 3:-

× and -

  • After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 × 13 + 9 - 18 ÷ 5 = 169

156 × 13 + 9 - 3.6 = 169

2028 + 9 - 3.6 = 169

2037 - 3.6 = 169

2033.4 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

From option 4:-

÷ and -

  • After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 ÷ 13 + 9 × 18 - 5 = 169

12 + 9 × 18 - 5 = 169

12 + 162 - 5 = 169
